new_tasks.objective: Test the login endpoint POST /rest/user/login (JSON body {email,password}) for SQL injection in the email field. The discover observation confirmed this endpoint returns 401 'Invalid email or password.' for a normal credential. Send one syntax-preserving derivative in email: "' OR 1=1--" with any password, and compare against at most two same-surface discriminating controls: (a) a normal non-existent email (baseline reject) and (b) a single stray quote "'" to see if the quote alone perturbs the response. Record status code, body, and any auth token / error differences as evidence of whether the email field reaches a SQL sink.
